newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks extend losses on Wall Street start.
newsitem.headline: French stocks extend losses on Wall Street start.

text.p: French shares extended their losses after a slide in the Dow Jones index of more than 50-points.

French stocks were already lower on profit-taking on the last day of the September account and due to some expectations that the Federal Reserve Open Market Commitee (FOMC) will raise the Fed funds rate on Tuesday by 0.25 points.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 13.90 points or 0.67 percent at 2,065.66 at 1431 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,071.5 from 2,082.5 on Friday's close.
Volume was a modest 2.6 billion francs.
* Peugeot down two percent to 571 francs after plunge in first half results.
* Pernod Ricard up 0.57 percent to 279.90 as company confirms it is studying a share buy-back plan.
